system.description:
The will of the spirits from the ancestral Tzimisce homeland weighs heavy on your blood — soil from a place merely important to you as a mortal won't do. You actually need two handfuls of the tainted Eastern European soil of the Tzimisce homeland to satisfy your soil dependence, no matter where you were sired or how many generations removed your ancestors relocated. This Flaw most commonly manifests in the childer of koldun and the branches of the clan thought to descend from Yorak. Characters Embraced in Eastern Europe can't take this Flaw, since they're already dependent on the local soil.

MET System: Until you are in possession of two handfuls of tainted Eastern European soil, you suffer a two-Trait penalty to all challenges.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
